runbooks.title: Connection pool exhaustion (Database connection timeout)
runbooks.text: Connection pool exhaustion. Class: Database connection timeout. Symptoms: Timeouts appear together with many requests waiting; pool usage at its maximum. Diagnosis: Compare pool_size against peak concurrency; check pool metrics and recent configuration changes. Remediation: Restore or raise the pool size; add pool-wait alerts. Typical errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "{host}" ({ip}), port 5432 failed: timeout expired | sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (psycopg2.OperationalError) connection timed out

runbooks.title: Database timeout setting lowered (Database connection timeout)
runbooks.text: Database timeout setting lowered. Class: Database connection timeout. Symptoms: Timeouts occur right after a deploy with no resource saturation. Diagnosis: Diff the connect/statement timeout values between the failing and last good release. Remediation: Revert to the previous timeout; derive limits from p99 handshake latency. Typical errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "{host}" ({ip}), port 5432 failed: timeout expired | sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (psycopg2.OperationalError) connection timed out

runbooks.title: Database server degradation (Database connection timeout)
runbooks.text: Database server degradation. Class: Database connection timeout. Symptoms: Timeouts with no related client change; query latency and DB CPU are elevated. Diagnosis: Check db_query_p95 and CPU; look for long-running queries and locks. Remediation: Kill or throttle the offending query; scale the instance; add query timeouts. Typical errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "{host}" ({ip}), port 5432 failed: timeout expired | sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (psycopg2.OperationalError) connection timed out

runbooks.title: Database service down (Database connection refused)
runbooks.text: Database service down. Class: Database connection refused. Symptoms: Refused connections everywhere, the target host reachable but nothing listening. Diagnosis: Check the db_up metric and instance status; confirm no recent maintenance. Remediation: Restore the instance; verify client reconnect logic. Typical errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "{host}" ({ip}), port {port} failed: Connection refused | Is the server running on that host and accepting TCP/IP connections?

runbooks.title: Database port misconfigured (Database connection refused)
runbooks.text: Database port misconfigured. Class: Database connection refused. Symptoms: Connection refused right after a config change; DB itself is healthy. Diagnosis: Compare the configured port to the port the database listens on. Remediation: Correct the port and add a startup connectivity check. Typical errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "{host}" ({ip}), port {port} failed: Connection refused | Is the server running on that host and accepting TCP/IP connections?

runbooks.title: Idle timeout mismatch (Database connection reset)
runbooks.text: Idle timeout mismatch. Class: Database connection reset. Symptoms: Resets hit the first query after a quiet period. Diagnosis: Compare client recycle/keepalive against the proxy and server idle timeouts. Remediation: Make the client recycle time shorter than every intermediary idle timeout. Typical errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: server closed the connection unexpectedly | This probably means the server terminated abnormally before or while processing the request.

runbooks.title: Database failover (Database connection reset)
runbooks.text: Database failover. Class: Database connection reset. Symptoms: Resets across many connections at the same moment with a failover event. Diagnosis: Check failover events and replication logs. Remediation: Retry with backoff; make tests tolerant of short failovers. Typical errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: server closed the connection unexpectedly | This probably means the server terminated abnormally before or while processing the request.

runbooks.title: Container memory limit reduced (Out-of-memory kill)
runbooks.text: Container memory limit reduced. Class: Out-of-memory kill. Symptoms: Kill with exit 137 right after a CI config change; memory graph pegged. Diagnosis: Compare the job memory limit to peak usage. Remediation: Restore the limit; add a memory budget test. Typical errors: Killed | make: *** [test] Error 137

runbooks.title: Unbounded cache regression (Out-of-memory kill)
runbooks.text: Unbounded cache regression. Class: Out-of-memory kill. Symptoms: Memory rises steadily until the kill, regardless of limit. Diagnosis: Look for caches, buffers and lists that never shrink in the recent diff. Remediation: Bound the cache; add an eviction test. Typical errors: Killed | make: *** [test] Error 137

runbooks.title: Verbose logging filled disk (Disk full)
runbooks.text: Verbose logging filled disk. Class: Disk full. Symptoms: Disk full after a run with very large log files. Diagnosis: Find the largest files; check log level changes. Remediation: Revert log level; enable rotation and size caps. Typical errors: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device | tar: write error: No space left on device

runbooks.title: Artifact cleanup step removed (Disk full)
runbooks.text: Artifact cleanup step removed. Class: Disk full. Symptoms: Gradual disk growth across runs, then ENOSPC. Diagnosis: Check the pipeline for cleanup/prune steps. Remediation: Restore pruning; add a disk usage gate. Typical errors: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device | tar: write error: No space left on device

runbooks.title: Service hostname renamed (DNS resolution failure)
runbooks.text: Service hostname renamed. Class: DNS resolution failure. Symptoms: One hostname fails to resolve while others work. Diagnosis: Compare configured hostnames with existing DNS records. Remediation: Fix the hostname; validate hosts at startup. Typical errors: socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution | urllib3.exceptions.NameResolutionError: Failed to resolve '{host}'

runbooks.title: DNS outage (DNS resolution failure)
runbooks.text: DNS outage. Class: DNS resolution failure. Symptoms: Many different hostnames fail at the same time; no config change. Diagnosis: Check resolver health and SERVFAIL rate. Remediation: Fail over resolvers; retry with backoff. Typical errors: socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution | urllib3.exceptions.NameResolutionError: Failed to resolve '{host}'

runbooks.title: Expired certificate (TLS certificate failure)
runbooks.text: Expired certificate. Class: TLS certificate failure. Symptoms: Handshake failures with certificate errors, no client change. Diagnosis: Inspect the certificate validity dates. Remediation: Renew the certificate; alert on days_remaining. Typical errors: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed | requests.exceptions.SSLError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='{host}', port=443)

runbooks.title: CA bundle removed or changed (TLS certificate failure)
runbooks.text: CA bundle removed or changed. Class: TLS certificate failure. Symptoms: Verification fails only for internal hosts after an image change. Diagnosis: Diff the Dockerfile for CA/cert steps. Remediation: Restore the CA install step. Typical errors: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed | requests.exceptions.SSLError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='{host}', port=443)

runbooks.title: Secret rotated without update (Authentication failure)
runbooks.text: Secret rotated without update. Class: Authentication failure. Symptoms: 401/invalid_grant after a credential rotation. Diagnosis: Check that every consumer was updated to the new secret. Remediation: Update the stale reference; rotate with overlap. Typical errors: requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://{host}/v1/deploy | oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.errors.InvalidGrantError: (invalid_grant)

runbooks.title: Token TTL reduced (Authentication failure)
runbooks.text: Token TTL reduced. Class: Authentication failure. Symptoms: Auth fails partway through long jobs. Diagnosis: Compare token TTL to the longest job duration. Remediation: Enable refresh or raise TTL. Typical errors: requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://{host}/v1/deploy | oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.errors.InvalidGrantError: (invalid_grant)

runbooks.title: Unpinned dependency bump (Dependency resolution conflict)

Diagnosis: Diff requirements/lockfile for loosened pins. Remediation: Re-pin and regenerate the lockfile. Typical errors: ERROR: Cannot install {pkg}=={ver} and {pkg2} because these package versions have conflicting dependencies. | ERROR: ResolutionImpossible: for help visit https://pip.pypa.io/en/latest/topics/dependency-resolution/

runbooks.text: Lockfile removed or stale. Class: Dependency resolution conflict. Symptoms: Dependency conflicts without any version edits. Diagnosis: Check whether the lockfile changed or disappeared. Remediation: Restore and regenerate the lockfile. Typical errors: ERROR: Cannot install {pkg}=={ver} and {pkg2} because these package versions have conflicting dependencies. | ERROR: ResolutionImpossible: for help visit https://pip.pypa.io/en/latest/topics/dependency-resolution/

runbooks.title: Race condition (Flaky test)
runbooks.text: Race condition. Class: Flaky test. Symptoms: Same commit passes and fails; failures cluster around concurrency. Diagnosis: Check flake rate history and rerun the test 20 times. Remediation: Fix the race; do not just retry. Typical errors: FAILED tests/test_{svc}.py::test_concurrent_update - AssertionError | ===== 1 failed, 214 passed, 1 rerun in 88.12s =====

runbooks.title: Retry storm (Rate limited)
runbooks.text: Retry storm. Class: Rate limited. Symptoms: 429s with a sharp request-rate spike following a client change. Diagnosis: Check retry/backoff settings. Remediation: Restore exponential backoff with jitter. Typical errors: requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 429 Client Error: Too Many Requests for url: https://{host}/v2/items | RateLimitError: rate limit exceeded, retry after {t}s
